name: wenzhi-plugins
description: Wenzhi Ding 的 ZCode 插件市场

plugins.name: humanize
plugins.description: 向会话注入「说人话」要求（每会话首轮全量规则，此后隔数轮再全量一次，其余轮一行提醒）：句子语法完整；非专业名词不用英文；英文习语用通行译法不逐字直译；不用空洞大词和 AI 套话；用户自己的用词照用不改写；会话回复和产出物（论文、报告、对外邮件等）都适用。研究相关的表达纪律（讲概念按前因后果、术语先白话后挂名）归 research-interpretation。

description_i18n.en: Injects plain-speech rules into the session (full rules on the first turn, then periodically, with one-line reminders in between): complete sentences; no jargon or translation-style Chinese; established translations for English idioms instead of word-for-word renderings; no hollow buzzwords or AI cliches; mirror the user's own wording without rewriting it; applies to chat replies and drafted artifacts (papers, reports, emails) alike. Research-adjacent expression discipline (cause-and-effect explanations, plain-language term introductions) lives in research-interpretation.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 向会话注入「说人话」要求（每会话首轮全量规则，此后隔数轮再全量一次，其余轮一行提醒）：句子语法完整；非专业名词不用英文；英文习语用通行译法不逐字直译；不用空洞大词和 AI 套话；用户自己的用词照用不改写；会话回复和产出物（论文、报告、对外邮件等）都适用。研究相关的表达纪律（讲概念按前因后果、术语先白话后挂名）归 research-interpretation。

plugins.name: model-providers
plugins.description: 模型厂商 provider 配置 registry：收录各家在 ZCode 中验证过的端点、kind 与 reasoning 档位，用 /providers-sync 同步到本机 config.json。

description_i18n.en: Provider config registry: verified endpoints, protocol kinds, and reasoning tiers per model vendor, synced into local config.json via /providers-sync.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 模型厂商 provider 配置 registry：收录各家在 ZCode 中验证过的端点、kind 与 reasoning 档位，用 /providers-sync 同步到本机 config.json。
